player.title: player
player.description: Player selector. May be a player name `string`  or a [selected target](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) of type player.

itemname.title: itemName
itemname.description: The item to clear. Clears all items if no specified. Item`ID`or block id.

data.title: data
data.description: The `item id` to be cleared. If not specified, all will be cleared. Default: `-1`.

maxcount.title: maxCount
maxcount.description: An `integer` that specifies how many items to clear.  Default: `-1`.
